node.title: Case insensitive hash key existance
node.author: merrymonk
node.doctext: I want to test the existence of a hash key so that the case of the key does not matter. I would prefer to do this in the normal way of </br> if(exists($data{$str})) {</br> where any of abcd, aBcd, AbcD and so on would pass for the key of abcd.</br> What is the simplest way of achieving this?
